model_card.summary: Two from-scratch 141,568-parameter byte-level TinyLMs trained separately on a TinyStories pilot and classical Chinese poetry.
model_card.scope: Inspect next-byte learning, held-out NLL and short continuations on small fixed source subsets.
limitations: TinyStories used 409/51/52 train/validation/test documents; poetry used 292/36/37. These are custom pilot splits, not upstream benchmark results.
Each 128-token context window resets its context. Whole-story generation, modern Chinese dialogue and factual accuracy were not established.
Exact deduplication and family separation were applied; near-duplicate clustering was not performed.
NLL is per predicted byte-token including EOS targets; bpb includes boundary-target NLL. English and Chinese corpus values do not measure interchangeable tasks.
